canvas.background: audio-backed runs use one checksum-registered fixed background from assets.json, with Sisters Room as the default; silent legacy sequences retain the implicit white canvas

timeline.action: Render every recipe frame through the recovered rig-v2 renderer.
timeline.hold: Clone the final rendered action frame for silent sequences. When lip-sync is active, re-render that same final body state for each hold frame while changing only its Mouth drawing.
timeline.gap: Insert no separator frames by default. When a positive gapFrames value is explicit, insert exactly that many white frames between actions; never insert a gap after the final action. A zero gap makes actions contiguous but does not create a polished blend.

previewExportParity: Smoke, proof, and final rendering all call the same renderRigFrame implementation.
audio: Optional user audio is staged locally and muxed as AAC. Its measured duration owns the audio-backed sequence length.
transcription: Before body-language planning, npm run transcribe turns the audio into local English text with word timestamps. Every audio-backed init regenerates transcript evidence. Expressive plans must name that preflight transcript SHA and anchor gestures to its exact words and frames. The transcript guides the agent but never renders, changes rig state, or replaces the audio.
lipSync: For audio-backed shaz-sequence-input-v1 runs, init generates Cherry 0.1.0 A-K/X cues with the bundled WASI module unless supplied cues or --lipsync=off are explicit. Cues map to five existing Shaz mouth drawings through the same renderRigFrame call. Body controls, deformations, props, and pose timing remain unchanged.
talkToCameraPreset: sequencePreset talk-to-camera resolves the entire measured audio duration to one gap-free hold of the registered neutral-listening body. Cherry controls only Mouth; the preset adds no body keys, props, camera motion, or second renderer.
semanticPerformanceLipSync: shaz-body-language-performance-v1 remains body-language-only; its audio drives measured duration and gesture scheduling, not mouth drawings. It receives the same local transcript evidence as other audio-backed runs.
backgroundSelection: Audio-backed sequences resolve their explicit backgroundId from assets.json. Semantic performance inputs may select the same registered IDs and default to assets.defaultBackgroundId when omitted. Background changes are input data rendered through the same character renderer and fixed stage view.
supportingMediaZone: map-photo-zone contains a clean empty wall area reserved in metadata for a future supporting-media feature. This Format does not accept, crop, place, or render supporting media there.
camera: Fixed for character dialogue; b-roll shots execute cinematic Ken Burns camera motion (pan / zoom) across full-screen illustrations.
characterFraming: Shaz is a waist-up rig. In audio-backed compositions the hoodie must continue below the bottom canvas edge in every frame, so its rounded lower boundary never reveals the missing legs. The same fixed stage view must also preserve clear left and right margins across every used action.
multiShotTimeline: shaz-multi-shot-v1 composes contiguous shots (talk-to-camera, chibi-commentary, b-roll, text-card) over continuous audio with zero frame gaps or desyncs. Text cards render bold typography with colored phrase highlights, chibi commentary pairs a reactive puppet with on-the-fly topic cards, and b-roll delivers Ken Burns visual storytelling.
